title: TechnologySummary
description: Local LLM -> backend. One object per (user, technology). This schema is passed to Ollama as `format`, so it must stay inside the subset Ollama's grammar compiler accepts: no $ref, no allOf/anyOf/oneOf, no pattern, no conditional keywords. It constrains syntax only -- a structurally valid object can still name an API the user never called, so the AI service must run the content checks in docs/ai/technology-summary-contract.md ch5 before returning anything.

tech_id.description: Echo of the requested tech_id. The AI service rejects the response when it differs -- a 4B model does substitute a neighbouring technology, and an unchecked swap would file Spring Security's summary under Spring Boot.

headline.description: One line naming what the person actually did with the technology. Shown as the card title, so it carries no level string: the level is rendered beside it and repeating it wastes the only line the card has.

summary.description: Two or three sentences restating the fact pack in Korean prose. Restatement, not inference -- every proper noun in it must already appear in highlights.value, next_level.missing, the display name, or a repository name.

gap.description: One sentence on what is missing for the next level, derived from next_level.missing. Null when next_level is null (the technology is already at its highest defined rule). This field, not summary, is what makes the card actionable: 'why not L3' is more useful to a person than 'why L2'.

used_highlights.description: Indexes of the highlights the summary leaned on. Indexes rather than evidence ids because a 4B model reproduces small integers reliably and 40-character ids it does not. The AI service checks every entry is in range; an out-of-range index means the model invented a fact and the whole response is discarded.

confidence.description: How specific the input was, not how sure the model feels. HIGH means highlights held an API_CALL the person wrote; MEDIUM means only imports or dependencies; LOW means authorship was NOT_VERIFIED or highlights was empty. The screen can hide LOW summaries without hiding the level, which stays rule-derived either way.
